testedSource: Uncommitted setup content identified by per-document SHA-256; included unchanged in the commit containing this report.
runtime: Codex collaboration subagents, inherited parent model; exact model identifier is not exposed by the collaboration API.
method: Three independent subagents without parent conversation history; four sequential scenarios per subagent, each with a fresh fixture session.
capabilities: Customer-facing tools are limited to the simulated host inventory. Shell/Python are used solely as offline fixture transport by instruction; broader subagent tools are not physically removed.
scope: Offline model behavior with recorded mock account and user responses. No real account sign-in, network calls, customer mutations, or installation during these evaluations.
grading: Parent reviewed recorded actions and final responses against evals/cases.json. Harness invariant checks supplement this review; no self-grading.
fixtureCorrections: Accepted macOS /tmp in addition to the per-user temporary directory; initial rejected starts created no sessions.
Resolved document URL fragments to the same snapshot after one evaluator recovered from a fixture 404 by removing the fragment. Regression test added.
limitations: Not a live ChatGPT, Claude, or other chat-product compatibility test.
No OAuth callback, admin policy, host UI, or fresh-chat persistence verification.
Scenarios within each subagent shared model context; these are functional probes, not independent statistical trials.
Public website guide and repository remain unpublished/private.
No support-directory link or richer recovery data exists in the unsupported-host and malformed-response fixtures, so those handoffs remain generic.
